newsitem.title: CHINA: Death toll from China bridge collapse rises to 29.
newsitem.headline: Death toll from China bridge collapse rises to 29.

text.p: The death toll from the collapse of a bridge under construction in southern China has risen to 29 with 60 injured, some seriously, officials said on Monday.

A 100-metre (109.4 yard) section of the almost-finished 160-metre bridge spanning a valley between Pingshi and Ruyuan counties in the north of Guangdong province crashed down on Friday morning, burying an estimated 90 workmen, officials said.

The death toll had risen to 29 after rescue workers and police, helped by the paramilitary People's Armed Police, had dug through the tonnes of debris, an official at the television station in the nearby city of Shaoguan said.
All the missing had been accounted for, he said.
The number of injured was placed at 60, he said. Officials said most of the workers were migrant labourers from other provinces.
A local health official said at the weekend that most of the injured had cuts or broken bones, and the most seriously hurt had been removed to hospitals in Shaoguan for treatment.
Officials said the cause of the collapse was under investigation.
